Espresso Flavoured
Field Notes

Welcome! This world is a little kinder to builders, so you can spend less time worrying and more time making something you love.

- Gabby

Your Home Bed

Crouch and use a bed with an empty hand to make it your home. Sleeping somewhere else doesn't move it.

Home is where rest counts: only a night here clears Drowsy, and Cozy heals you nearby.

Looking After Yourself

You only heal while you've eaten recently, so keep a snack handy.

Three days without a night at home and you turn Drowsy: no sprinting, slower mining. Coffee holds it off while it lasts.

Coffee Corner

Roast coffee cherries, then brew them in an espresso machine on a coffee bar. Mugs are fired clay.

Away three days? Only your own bed leaves you rested. Decaf helps you sleep well.

Bean Coins

Every advancement in the Espresso Flavoured tab pays you a Bean Coin.

A master barista (a villager with an espresso machine) takes them: eight buy the Golden Mug, and one or two buy a treat.

Café Charms

A master barista sells a charm or two for Bean Coins, and they turn up in café and village chests.

Wear them in trinket slots, or hold one in your off-hand. Each has a small perk, from a Lucky Bean to a Thermos.

If You Fall

The charms you're wearing stay with you. With Cozy Core, so do your hotbar and armour, and in the Espresso Flavoured pack the rest waits in a grave where you fell.

Happy building!
